tooltip.mekaweapons.magnetizer: Charges your inventory items with energy from the selected frequency. Also displays the Weapons on your back (when equipped on Curios).
tooltip.mekaweapons.infuser: Transfers the enchantments of an enchanted book into the Enchantment Unit installed on a weapon.
gui.mekaweapons.infuser_remove: Remove and return as a book
description.mekaweapons.arrowenergy_unit: Fire arrows made of pure energy. Removes the need for ammunition.
description.mekaweapons.autofire_unit: Fires automatically when the Meka-Bow is fully charged.
description.mekaweapons.drawspeed_unit: Increases the draw speed of the Meka-Bow.
description.mekaweapons.gravitydampener_: Defy gravity with the power of Antimatter. Full charged shots go straight to the target.
description.mekaweapons.arrowvelocity_un: Multiply the velocity of the arrows.
description.mekaweapons.attackamplificat: Amplifies a weapon's offensive output using stabilized atomic energy.
description.mekaweapons.sweeping_unit: Enables sweeping attacks with the Meka-Tana.
description.mekaweapons.looting_unit: Cause mobs to drop more items and increase the chances of rare drops when using Meka-Weapons.
description.mekaweapons.punch_unit: Arrows fired by the Meka-Bow knock their target back further.
description.mekaweapons.fireaspect_unit: Sets targets struck by the Meka-Tana on fire.
description.mekaweapons.knockback_unit: Targets struck by the Meka-Tana are knocked back further.
description.mekaweapons.cooling_unit: Vents the Meka-Gun heat faster, at the cost of extra energy per shot.
description.mekaweapons.chemicalarrow_un: Adds a chemical tank to the Meka-Bow and infuses its arrows with the stored chemical. Accepts hydrogen, sulfuric acid, hydrogen chloride and water vapor.
description.mekaweapons.enchantment_unit: Holds up to 4 enchantments infused from enchanted books using the Enchantment Infuser, and applies them to the weapon.
